name: KAUST MS + KAUST Fellowship (Computer Science / ECE / Statistics; AI research)
host: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
coverage: Every admitted student automatically receives the KAUST Fellowship: full tuition, a living stipend, on-campus accommodation, health insurance and relocation assistance. There is no separate fellowship application.
amount: Full tuition + stipend (KAUST does not publish the figure; third-party sites report about USD 20,000/yr for MS, unverified). KAUST says students spend about USD 1,320/month on average and the stipend 'more than covers' that. Free housing on campus.
fields: Computer Science (MS and MS/PhD), Electrical & Computer Engineering, Statistics, Applied Math & Computational Science; AI/ML research groups inside these programmes
eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's degree, minimum GPA 3.0/4. KAUST says about 90% of admitted applicants have GPA above 3.3 and 75% above 3.5. Must be at least 18. CV, statement of purpose, and 3 referees.
english: MOI certificates are NOT accepted, and KAUST says it grants no English waivers. The only exemption is a degree completed in person in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia or New Zealand. Accepted tests: IELTS 7.0 (6.5 in every band; IELTS Online accepted), TOEFL iBT 5 on the new 1-6 scale (4.5 in every section; Home Edition accepted), PTE 71 (67 in every section), Cambridge C1/C2 185. Duolingo is NOT accepted. You can submit the score after you apply, if your application progresses.
gre: Not required (a strong score may help)
deadline: Fall 2027 (Round 2) opens 28 Sep 2026 and closes 3 Jan 2027. Decisions on 25 Feb 2027; classes start 29 Aug 2027. KAUST calls these dates tentative.
fitReason: Fully funded, with no fee, no GRE, and work options in Saudi Arabia after graduation. The deadline is about 11 weeks away. The catches: IELTS 7.0 is unavoidable because MOI is not accepted, and a GPA of 3.41 sits around the median of admitted students, so research experience (the retinal multimodal DL project, LLM/RAG work) and strong references matter.
steps: Create an account at apply.kaust.edu.sa and pick MS (or MS/PhD) in Computer Science for Fall 2027.
Upload your transcript (a partial transcript is OK), CV, statement of purpose and passport page. Enter the details of 3 referees, who must submit within 7 days of the deadline.
Book IELTS Academic (target 7.0 with 6.5 in every band) or TOEFL iBT. You can upload the score later if your application progresses.
Submit by 3 Jan 2027. There is no application fee.
Answer any interview invitation quickly. Decisions come out around 25 Feb 2027, and the fellowship terms are in the offer letter.

name: MBZUAI MSc (Machine Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, Robotics, Computer Science and others)
host: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Abu Dhabi
coverage: For Fall 2027 MSc entry, admission does NOT include funding automatically. Funding comes from a merit-based university award, a faculty-sponsored research or teaching assistantship, or an approved government scholarship. Funded students get tuition, a monthly stipend, en-suite on-campus housing, health insurance, return airfare and visa sponsorship. The fee-based MSc in Applied AI (MAAI) gets no funding.
amount: An older official page gave AED 8,000/month for international MSc students. A 2026 news report says AED 15,500/month. Neither figure is confirmed for 2027. Tuition waived when funded; free housing.
fields: MSc Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Robotics, Computer Science, plus newer programmes
eligibility: Any nationality. Relevant STEM bachelor's degree. GPA guide is about 3.0–3.5/4 depending on the programme. SOP, research statement, referees, and a CV that shows technical depth.
english: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90, PTE 60, Duolingo 120, Cambridge C1 180 / C2 200. Only centre-based versions count. The FAQ waives the test only for a degree taught entirely in English in a country where English is both an official language and the dominant language of higher education. Whether a Pakistani English-medium degree qualifies is UNCLEAR, so ask admissions. A plain MOI letter alone is probably not enough.
deadline: Portal opened 1 Sep 2026; final deadline 15 Dec 2026; decisions by 31 Mar 2027; Fall 2027 starts mid-August 2027. Funding is competitive, so apply early.
bond: None found (UAE work after graduation is possible via an employer visa or the Golden Visa for outstanding graduates; not verified)
fitReason: This is the world's most AI-focused university, it is near Karachi, and Abu Dhabi has a strong AI job market for an earn-then-return plan. The 2027 policy change means funding is no longer guaranteed, and the deadline is 15 Dec 2026. Applying for the waiver might avoid IELTS, but get it confirmed in writing.
steps: Read the 2027 graduate master's admissions page and choose one MSc (ML, CV or NLP fit your LLM/RAG and retinal-imaging background best).
Email admissions asking whether a FAST-NUCES English-medium BS qualifies for the English waiver. If it does not, book IELTS 6.5 at a test centre (not online).
Prepare your transcript, degree, CV, SOP, research statement and referee contacts. Link your projects or GitHub.
Apply on the MBZUAI portal before 15 Dec 2026 and say you want to be considered for merit funding and RA/TA support.
Email MBZUAI faculty whose labs match your interests, because faculty-sponsored RA funding is a main route to a stipend.
Complete any assessment or interview. Decisions arrive by 31 Mar 2027.

name: HBKU College of Science & Engineering MS (Computer Science / Data Science & Engineering / Cybersecurity) with HBKU scholarship
host: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (Qatar Foundation)
coverage: Competitive scholarship: 75% tuition waiver for STEM master's in CSE, a monthly stipend for international students for up to 21 months, and one round-trip airfare. Awards must be renewed each year. Self-funded students pay a discounted rate of QAR 2,000 per credit hour.
amount: QAR 7,000/month stipend (international master's, up to 21 months) + 75% tuition waiver + airfare
fields: Computer Science, Data Science and Engineering, Cybersecurity, and other CSE programmes; QCRI does AI/Arabic NLP research
eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's degree with minimum GPA 3.0/4. You are considered for funding automatically through admission. CSE gives a limited number of waivers.
english: IELTS or TOEFL is normally required. Whether an MOI letter is accepted is not confirmed, so check the CSE admission-requirements page or ask admissions.
gre: Unknown (some CSE programmes have listed GRE as optional)
deadline: Application opened 1 Oct 2026; deadline for international applicants 1 Feb 2027 (Fall 2027)
fitReason: Doha is close to Pakistan and has a real tech job market. The stipend of about USD 1,900/month is enough to live on, and a GPA of 3.41 clears the 3.0 minimum. The remaining 25% of tuition is roughly QAR 2,000 x 25% per credit hour, which the stipend can absorb. English test rules are still unconfirmed.
steps: Open the CSE admission-requirements page and confirm the English test minimum, GRE status and programme list.
Create an account on the HBKU graduate application portal (open since 1 Oct 2026).
Upload your transcripts, degree, CV, personal statement and referee details, and pay the application fee.
Submit before 1 Feb 2027. You are considered for the scholarship automatically.
Interview with the college, receive the offer and scholarship letter, then get your Qatar student residence permit through HBKU.

name: Khalifa University Master's Research/Teaching Scholarship (MRTS), MSc Computer Science / AI-related
host: Khalifa University of Science and Technology, Abu Dhabi
coverage: Full tuition, a monthly stipend, flights at the start and end of study for international students, and medical insurance. Accommodation is NOT covered. You are considered for the scholarship as part of admission.
amount: Full tuition (normally AED 5,000 per credit hour) + monthly stipend. The official page gives no amount; aggregator sites report AED 8,000/month, unverified.
fields: MSc Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Robotics, and other engineering and computing master's degrees
eligibility: Any nationality, full-time study. Relevant bachelor's degree with CGPA 3.0/4 or higher. Two references, a 500–1,000 word SOP, and an admission interview. One programme per semester. Application fee AED 200.
english: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 91 (centre-based, no Home Edition). Graduates of English-medium institutions get a lower bar (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 79) but must still show a score, so in practice an MOI letter alone is NOT enough. Conditional admission is possible at IELTS 6.0.
gre: Not required for master's (the GRE is mentioned only for direct-PhD applicants)
deadline: Fall 2027 dates not yet published; Spring 2027 is closed. The last published cycle ran 23 Dec 2024 to 14 Apr 2025 (label: previous cycle). Expect roughly Dec 2026 to Apr 2027.
fitReason: This is the UAE's top-ranked research university, the scholarship is strong and you stay in Abu Dhabi. However, housing is not covered and IELTS is effectively required. A good backup to MBZUAI.
steps: Sign up on ku.ac.ae/postgraduate-admissions to be told when the Fall 2027 cycle opens.
Take IELTS Academic (6.5, or 6.0 for conditional admission).
Get an equivalency or attestation for your degree as the UAE Ministry of Education requires (HEC attestation first).
Apply online, pay AED 200, and upload your degree, transcripts, IELTS score, SOP and passport. Referees submit online.
Attend the interview. If admitted, the MRTS terms appear in your offer.

name: American University of Sharjah Graduate Assistantship (MS Computer Engineering / Engineering Systems & Management, etc.)
host: American University of Sharjah
coverage: Competitive graduate assistantship: a tuition waiver of up to 9 credit hours per semester and/or a stipend, for up to 4 semesters, in return for up to 20 hours/week of work. It does NOT cover housing, health insurance or activity fees.
amount: Tuition waiver up to 9 credit hours/semester + stipend up to AED 20,000/semester (about AED 3,300–5,000/month)
fields: MS Computer Engineering, MS Electrical Engineering, MS Engineering Systems & Management, Mechatronics
eligibility: Admitted full-time graduate students; awarded on merit. You apply on the admission form.
english: TOEFL, IELTS or EmSAT is normally required. MOI policy not verified.
deadline: Not verified for Fall 2027. Check the AUS graduate admissions calendar, where the Fall deadline has usually been in spring.
bond: None found (work duties of up to 20 hrs/week during study)
fitReason: This is a partial package: you pay for housing and insurance yourself, which your PKR 10–15 lakh could just about cover. Sharjah and Dubai jobs are within reach. It is less AI-focused than MBZUAI or KAUST.
steps: Choose an MS programme (Computer Engineering fits best).
Apply on the AUS graduate application and tick the graduate assistantship request on the form.
Submit English test scores, transcripts and references.
If you get the award, sign the per-semester contract issued by the Office of Graduate Studies.

name: UAE University Graduate Research / Teaching Assistantship (MSc IT / Computer Science)
host: United Arab Emirates University (Al Ain), College of Graduate Studies
coverage: Tuition waiver + monthly stipend for research or teaching assistants. Research assistantships are funded by a supervisor's grant.
amount: Monthly stipend (amount not verified; set by department budget)
fields: MSc Information Technology / Computer Science / Software Engineering / AI tracks
eligibility: GPA 3.0/4 or higher. Depends on supervisor approval and available research grants.
english: IELTS/TOEFL/EmSAT per College of Graduate Studies rules; MOI acceptance not verified
deadline: Not verified. One aggregator listed 31 Mar 2026 for the last cycle. Research assistantships are offered all year when projects open.
fitReason: A possible fallback in the UAE, but the stipend and deadlines are not published officially and Al Ain is a smaller job market.
steps: Find UAEU CIT faculty with funded projects and email them your CV.
Apply to the MSc through the UAEU graduate admission portal.
Request a GRA/GTA through the College of Graduate Studies once your supervisor agrees.

name: Qatar University Graduate Assistantship (MSc Computing)
host: Qatar University
coverage: A 12-month competitive assistantship contract, renewable up to 2 years for master's students. The policy says the awardee pays their own housing, tuition, insurance and travel. The QU FAQ says there are no academic scholarships for graduate students.
amount: Hourly pay (the 2015/16 catalog gave QR 180/hr; current rate unverified). Tuition is QAR 2,200 per credit hour.
fields: MSc Computing, MSc Cyber Security, Data Science
eligibility: Admitted graduate students (Qatar or abroad) with GPA 3.0 or higher. Must take 9 credit hours each semester.
english: IELTS/TOEFL required; MOI not verified
deadline: Unknown for Fall 2027
fitReason: This is not real full funding, because tuition and living costs stay with you. HBKU is the better Qatar option.
steps: Apply for admission to a QU master's.
Send the GA application with your CV to the college's Associate Dean for Research and Graduate Studies.
Confirm the stipend with graduatestudies@qu.edu.qa.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) 2027, Graduate University Track (e.g. KAIST, POSTECH, SNU, Korea Univ., Yonsei, UNIST, GIST)
host: NIIED / Korean Ministry of Education
coverage: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, round-trip airfare, settlement allowance, medical insurance, a 1-year Korean language course, research allowance and completion grant
amount: About KRW 1,000,000/month (graduate) + tuition + airfare + KRW 200,000 settlement (based on recent cycles; unverified for 2027)
fields: Any field, including CS/AI at Korean universities that take part
eligibility: Pakistani citizens are eligible (Pakistan is a GKS country). Under 40. Bachelor's degree with CGPA of 80% or higher (3.41/4 is fine). You may apply to only ONE university and one department on the University Track.
english: No IELTS is required to apply. TOPIK or English test scores (TOEFL/IELTS) earn extra points but are optional. The language year is in Korean. Many English-taught CS programmes accept an MOI or English-medium certificate (check each university).
deadline: 2027 University Track: each university publishes its own window, usually late Feb to late Mar 2027. Example from the previous cycle: 23 Feb to 20 Mar 2026. Results around end of June 2027.
bond: None found (Korea offers a D-10 job-seeking visa after graduation)
fitReason: This is one of the few fully funded options that does not require IELTS and is open to Pakistanis, and KAIST/POSTECH CS are strong in AI. The drawback is the compulsory Korean year (start would be 2027 language, 2028 degree), and the job market for English-only speakers is weaker than in the Gulf.
steps: From Jan 2027, watch studyinkorea.go.kr for the 2027 GKS Graduate Application Guidelines.
Pick ONE university and department on the University Track list, ideally a lab whose professor you have emailed in advance.
Get HEC-attested and apostilled degree and transcripts, a passport, 2 recommendation letters, a personal statement and a study plan (NIIED forms), plus a health form.
Submit by post or online directly to the chosen university within its Feb–Mar 2027 window.
University selection, then NIIED final selection in about June 2027, then the visa, then arrival around Aug 2027.

name: KAIST International Graduate Admission with KAIST scholarship (MS School of Computing / Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI)
host: KAIST
coverage: Choose 'KAIST scholarship' as your funding source when you apply: full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend (paid partly through lab research assistant work), and national health insurance
amount: Full tuition + base stipend (figures differ by source: KRW 350,000/month base plus lab RA top-up, up to about KRW 1,000,000/month for top awards; unverified)
fields: MS Computing, Graduate School of AI, Electrical Engineering
eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's degree. Merit selection. Application fee about KRW 80,000.
english: TOEFL/IELTS normally required unless your degree was taught in English. KAIST has historically accepted proof of an English-medium degree, but this is not verified for 2027.
deadline: Spring 2027 is closed (1 Sep 2026). Fall 2027 is expected as an Early track around Dec 2026 and a Regular track around Mar 2027 (unverified).
fitReason: A top AI school, with no GRE and possibly no IELTS. The stipend alone is small unless a lab tops it up, so email professors before you apply.
steps: Check admission.kaist.ac.kr for the Fall 2027 international graduate guidelines (expected Nov–Dec 2026).
Email Computing or AI-school professors with your CV and retinal-DL/LLM work.
Apply online, choose 'KAIST scholarship' as the funding source, and upload your transcripts, SOP, study plan and recommender details.
Interview if shortlisted; take the D-2 visa.

name: POSTECH Graduate School (MS Computer Science & Engineering / AI) with full funding
host: Pohang University of Science and Technology
coverage: Graduate students are normally funded with a tuition waiver plus a monthly stipend through their lab or advisor
amount: Full tuition + monthly stipend (amount not verified)
fields: Computer Science & Engineering, Graduate School of AI, Electrical Engineering
eligibility: Any nationality. Admission is usually advisor-driven.
english: TOEFL/IELTS or proof of an English-medium degree (not verified)
deadline: Fall 2027 international round expected around Mar–May 2027 (not verified)
fitReason: Strong research funding and possibly no test, but Pohang is a small city and a Korean-language job market is a barrier for an earn-then-return plan.
steps: Find a CSE/AI professor and email your CV and research interests.
Apply to the POSTECH international graduate admission online.
Confirm the stipend in the offer.

name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship, University Recommendation route (e.g. UTokyo Graduate School of Information Science & Technology, Science Tokyo, Hokkaido)
host: MEXT, with recommendation from a Japanese university
coverage: Tuition, admission and exam fees, a monthly allowance and return airfare
amount: About JPY 144,000/month (master's), plus tuition and airfare (rate reported by third parties; check the guidelines)
fields: Information science, computer science, AI in English-taught graduate programmes
eligibility: Pakistan has diplomatic relations with Japan and is eligible. Your first study abroad in Japan. You must not be applying through the Embassy route at the same time. Many schools need an informal acceptance from a professor first. UTokyo IST students first enter as non-degree research students, then pass the master's entrance exam.
english: Depends on the school. English-taught programmes often take TOEFL/IELTS, and some accept proof of an English-medium degree. Not verified.
gre: Not required (some schools ask for GRE or their own exam)
deadline: Each school sets its own date for October 2027 entry, roughly Oct 2026 to Jan 2027. Hokkaido Engineering took applications 20–29 Oct 2026; UTokyo IST has published Oct 2027 guidelines. Several windows may already be closing.
bond: None found (Japan offers job-seeking status after graduation)
fitReason: Fully funded, possibly with no IELTS, and Pakistanis are eligible. It needs fast action because deadlines fall in Oct 2026 to Jan 2027, and it needs a professor's support. Japan's English-only job market is limited.
steps: This week, list Oct-2027 MEXT University Recommendation calls (UTokyo IST, Science Tokyo, Hokkaido, Tohoku, Osaka, Kyushu) and their deadlines.
Email the target lab professor for an informal acceptance and send your research plan.
Email the school to confirm Pakistan is in its quota, as UTokyo IST requires.
Submit the school's MEXT application packet: transcripts, research plan, recommendations, and English proof if asked.
The university screens you, then MEXT makes the final decision. You arrive Sep–Oct 2027.

name: MEXT Research Scholarship 2027, Embassy Recommendation (Embassy of Japan in Pakistan)
host: MEXT via the Embassy of Japan, Islamabad / Consulate-General Karachi
coverage: Tuition, monthly allowance and airfare
amount: About JPY 144,000/month (master's) + tuition + airfare
fields: Any field, including information science
eligibility: Pakistani nationals under 35. The embassy runs a written test and interview.
english: The embassy's own English (or Japanese) written test. No IELTS is needed.
deadline: The 2027 cycle (for April/Oct 2027 entry) has closed; it took applications around spring 2026. Next cycle (2028 entry) expected around Apr–May 2027.
fitReason: Too late for a 2027 start, so this is only a 2028 fallback. Use the University Recommendation route instead.
steps: Watch the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan page from about March 2027 for the 2028 call.
Submit the application to the Karachi consulate, take the written test, then the interview.

name: JDS (Project for Human Resource Development Scholarship), Pakistan 2027 intake
host: JICA / JICE
coverage: Full master's at a Japanese university: tuition, stipend, airfare
amount: Fully funded (16 seats for Pakistan)
fields: Public administration/finance/governance (11), industrial promotion/investment climate (3), climate change/energy policy (2). There is no CS/AI track.
eligibility: Pakistani government officers aged 25–40 with 3 or more years of full-time public service, mainly federal BPS-17 or above. Private-sector applicants are NOT eligible.
english: JDS's own English test during selection
bond: Return to government service in Pakistan (it is a government HRD programme)
fitReason: Not eligible: the applicant works in the private sector and the fields are not CS/AI. Listed only to rule it out.
steps: Not applicable for this applicant.

name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP) at the Asian Institute of Technology (MSc Data Science & AI / Computer Science / ICT)
host: Asian Development Bank (funded by Japan); AIT is a Designated Institution
coverage: Full tuition, monthly subsistence and housing allowance, books, medical insurance and travel
amount: Fully funded (ADB-set subsistence; amount not verified)
fields: AIT master's programmes approved by ADB, which include data science/AI and ICT-related degrees
eligibility: Nationals of ADB borrowing member countries. Pakistan IS eligible, and AIT's page confirms ADB-JSP for borrowing countries. You need at least 2 years of full-time work after your bachelor's (the applicant has about 1.5–2 years, so it is borderline: count the years by Aug 2027). There is an upper age limit (usually 35). You must be admitted to the Designated Institution first, and the Designated Institution nominates you.
english: AIT accepts IELTS/TOEFL or its own AIT English Entrance Test (EET), which may avoid IELTS. MOI acceptance not verified.
deadline: AIT deadline for ADB-JSP, August 2027 intake: 31 Mar 2027
bond: ADB-JSP expects scholars to return home and contribute to their country's development after study (a moral expectation rather than a financial bond)
fitReason: Fully funded, possibly with no IELTS by using AIT's EET, and Pakistanis qualify. The work-experience rule is borderline and the scholarship expects you to return home. Bangkok AI salaries are moderate.
steps: Count your full-time work months after graduation. You need 24 or more by the time ADB checks.
Apply for admission to an AIT master's (for example Data Science & AI) online and tick ADB-JSP as the funding source.
Prepare your transcripts, degree, CV, employer certificates, 2 references and a statement linking the degree to Pakistan's development.
Take the AIT EET (online) or submit IELTS/TOEFL.
Submit by 31 Mar 2027. AIT nominates you, then ADB makes the final selection.

name: Royal Thai Government Scholarships at AIT (H.M. the King's / H.M. the Queen's / Loom Nam Khong Pijai)
host: Royal Thai Government, administered by AIT
coverage: Tuition, accommodation and a living bursary for the full 22-month master's
amount: Full tuition + on-campus housing + monthly bursary (amount not verified)
fields: AIT master's programmes, including ICT and Data Science & AI
eligibility: Limited to specific countries. Loom Nam Khong Pijai is for Mekong (GMS) countries. Whether Pakistan qualifies for the King's or Queen's awards was NOT verified.
english: AIT EET or IELTS/TOEFL
deadline: Deadline for August 2027 intake: 31 Mar 2027
fitReason: Pakistan's eligibility is uncertain. Ask AIT admissions when you apply for ADB-JSP.
steps: Ask AIT admissions whether Pakistani nationals are eligible for the RTG scholarship.
Apply to the AIT master's and select the RTG scholarship by 31 Mar 2027.

name: HKUST MPhil (research) in Computer Science & Engineering with Postgraduate Studentship (PGS)
host: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
coverage: A monthly Postgraduate Studentship for up to 2 years for full-time MPhil students. Tuition is charged to non-local students (the tuition waiver is for local students) but is usually far smaller than the PGS.
amount: HK$19,135/month in 2025/26 (HK$229,620/yr in 2026/27, about USD 29,400/yr). Non-local tuition is about HK$42,100–49,500/yr (unverified).
fields: MPhil Computer Science & Engineering, Electronic & Computer Engineering, AI thrust (Guangzhou campus)
eligibility: Any nationality. Strong academics and research potential. Usually needs a supervisor willing to take you.
english: TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.5 unless your degree was taught in English. HKUST has accepted English-medium degrees as an exemption, but this is not verified for 2027.
deadline: Fall 2027 RPG rounds are usually Dec 2026 to Feb 2027 for scholarship consideration (unverified)
bond: None found (Hong Kong's IANG visa gives 2 years of open work after graduation)
fitReason: A paid research master's at a top-50 university: the stipend of about USD 2,400/month easily covers tuition and rent, it may not need IELTS, and the IANG visa suits an earn-then-return plan. Competitive, so a research angle (retinal multimodal DL) is essential.
steps: Shortlist CSE faculty and email 3–5 of them with your CV and project summary (Nov 2026).
Apply through the HKUST FYTGS online application for MPhil CSE, Fall 2027, before the first-round deadline.
Upload your transcripts, CV, research statement and referee details, plus an English-medium proof or test score.
Attend the interview. The PGS is stated in the offer.

name: HKU MPhil (Computer Science) with Postgraduate Scholarship
host: The University of Hong Kong
coverage: A monthly Postgraduate Scholarship for research students, for the normal study period
amount: About HK$18,000–19,000/month (unverified); tuition about HK$42,100/yr
fields: MPhil Computer Science, Data Science, EEE
eligibility: Any nationality; you need a supervisor
english: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 unless your degree was taught in English (exemption not verified)
deadline: Main round usually 1 Dec 2026 (unverified)
fitReason: Similar to HKUST but with fewer MPhil places in CS. The HKU taught MSc(AI) is self-funded with only a small entrance award.
steps: Email HKU CS faculty.
Apply on the HKU Graduate School RPg portal before the main round.
Interview, then receive the offer with the scholarship.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC), University Program (Type B), English-taught CS/AI master's at Tsinghua / SJTU / Zhejiang
host: China Scholarship Council via host university
coverage: Tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly stipend, comprehensive medical insurance
amount: CNY 3,000/month (master's) + tuition + housing + insurance (standard CSC rates; unverified for 2027)
fields: English-taught CS/AI/EE master's (Tsinghua Advanced Computing, SJTU EE/CS, ZJU Computer Science and Technology, etc.)
eligibility: Pakistani citizens (Pakistan gets one of the largest CSC quotas). Under 35. Bachelor's degree. You apply to the university and to the CSC portal (agency number from the university).
english: IELTS 6.0–6.5 or TOEFL 80–90 for English programmes. Several universities accept an English-medium certificate (MOI) from native or English-medium degrees, but this varies and is not verified.
deadline: 2027 dates not published. Expected: Tsinghua around Jan 2027, SJTU and ZJU around Feb–Mar 2027; CSC portal opens around Dec 2026.
bond: None found (but post-study work in China is hard for foreigners)
fitReason: Very winnable for Pakistanis and fully funded, possibly with an MOI letter. However, earning in China after graduation is difficult, so it fits poorly with an earn-then-return plan unless you then move to the Gulf.
steps: Get the university agency number for CSC Type B from Tsinghua/SJTU/ZJU international admissions (Nov–Dec 2026).
Register on campuschina.org, fill in the CSC application, and print it.

Apply on the university's own portal: study plan, 2 recommendation letters from professors, notarised degree and transcripts, Foreigner Physical Examination Form, and a pre-acceptance letter if available.
Email a professor for a pre-acceptance letter, which greatly improves your chances.
Results come in Jun–Jul 2027, followed by the JW202 form and X1 visa.

name: Schwarzman Scholars (Master's in Global Affairs, Tsinghua University)
host: Schwarzman Scholars / Tsinghua University
coverage: Full tuition, room and board, travel, stipend, health insurance
amount: Fully funded 1-year master's
fields: Global Affairs (with a technology/AI policy track). NOT a CS master's.
eligibility: Pakistan is eligible. Undergraduate degree. Aged 18–28 (under 29 on 1 Aug of the enrolment year). Leadership-focused.
english: MOI IS accepted: the test is waived if the primary language of instruction at your undergraduate institution was English for at least 2 years. Otherwise TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7 / Duolingo 130.
deadline: The Class of 2027-28 is closed. Class of 2028-29 (starting Aug 2028): global application Apr–Sep 2027.
fitReason: It accepts MOI and is prestigious, but it is not CS/AI and the earliest start is Aug 2028, so it does not fit a technical 2027 plan.
steps: Sign up for updates. Apply Apr–Sep 2027 if you want an Aug 2028 policy/leadership year.

name: NTU / NTHU / NYCU International Student Scholarships (English-taught CS/AI master's)
host: National Taiwan University, National Tsing Hua University, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
coverage: Tuition and fee waivers and/or a monthly stipend, given on merit at admission, for up to 2 years
amount: NTHU master's: Type A NT$5,000/month + fee waiver, or Type B fees only. NYCU: NT$7,000–30,000/month in reports. NTU: reports of up to NT$30,000/month for top awards. All amounts unverified.
fields: CSIE / Data Science / AI master's taught in English
eligibility: Any foreign nationality (Pakistan OK for university scholarships); new international degree students
english: Most accept TOEFL/IELTS or an English-medium certificate (MOI) for English programmes. Varies by department; not verified.
deadline: NTU 2027 September entry first round opened 29 Sep 2026 (official OIA). NTHU and NYCU fall rounds usually run Dec 2026 to Mar 2027.
bond: None found (Taiwan allows a job-seeking stay and has the Gold Card)
fitReason: Low tuition (about USD 1,500–2,500/semester), possibly with MOI. However, most awards are partial, so full funding happens only with a lab RA. Taiwan semiconductor and AI jobs exist, but Mandarin helps.
steps: Pick English-taught programmes (NTU CSIE/GIDS, NTHU CS, NYCU CS/AI).
Apply on each university's international degree portal and tick the scholarship box (NTU first round open now).
Upload your transcripts, financial statement, SOP, study plan, 2 recommendations, and English proof (MOI if accepted).
Email lab professors about RA funding.

name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
host: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund
coverage: Tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, insurance, airfare
amount: About NT$15,000/month + tuition + housing + airfare (previous cycles)
fields: Designated ICDF programmes (some ICT and engineering)
eligibility: Only citizens of countries on ICDF's list of eligible countries, mostly Taiwan's diplomatic allies and partners. Pakistan was NOT confirmed on the official list; one unofficial blog says it is.
english: TOEFL/IELTS or an English-proficiency certificate
deadline: 2027 cycle expected around 1 Dec 2026 to about 15 Mar 2027 (unofficial)
bond: Expected to return and contribute to your home country (development scholarship)
fitReason: Pakistan is probably not on the list. Check the 2027 guidebook country list before spending time.
steps: Download the 2027 TaiwanICDF guidebook (around Dec 2026) and check the country list for Pakistan.
If eligible, apply to both the ICDF portal and the partner university.

name: MOE Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education, via TECO)
host: Taiwan Ministry of Education
coverage: Tuition (up to NT$40,000/semester) + monthly stipend
amount: NT$20,000/month (master's) + up to NT$40,000/semester tuition
fields: Any
eligibility: You apply through the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office for your country. There is no TECO in Pakistan, and the regional office's 2025 call was limited to Jordan, Egypt, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Libya. Pakistan appears NOT eligible.
english: TOEFL/IELTS
deadline: Usually 1 Feb to 31 Mar each year (last cycle 2025: 1 Feb–31 Mar 2025)
fitReason: Pakistan does not appear in any TECO call found.
steps: Only worth a check: email the MOE / regional TECO to ask whether Pakistan has a 2027 quota.

name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
host: Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia
coverage: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, airfare, insurance, settling-in allowance
amount: Tuition + RM 1,500/month (about USD 330)
fields: Science, technology, ICT at Malaysian public universities (UM, UTM, UPM, USM, UKM)
eligibility: Citizens of the MIS recipient-country list only. Pakistan was not confirmed on the 2026/27 list (26 nationalities). You need an offer from a Malaysian university.
english: IELTS/TOEFL, or the university's acceptance of an English-medium degree
deadline: Last cycle (2026/27) ran 4 Mar to 3 Apr 2026. The 2027/28 cycle is expected around Mar–Apr 2027 (unconfirmed).
fitReason: The stipend is low, Pakistan's eligibility is uncertain, and the Malaysian AI job market is moderate.
steps: Check the recipient-country list on biasiswa.mohe.gov.my/INTER when the 2027 call opens.
Get an offer from a Malaysian public university and apply online.

name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship for Foreign Students (UBD / UTB master's)
host: Government of Brunei Darussalam (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
coverage: Tuition, accommodation, monthly allowance, return airfare, books and food allowances
amount: Full scholarship (monthly allowance about BND 500; unverified)
fields: UBD Computer Science / Data Science; UTB Computing and AI-related master's
eligibility: Foreign nationals aged 35 or under (master's). The application must be endorsed by your own government ministry or embassy. Pakistan's eligibility was NOT confirmed. Applicants who have studied in Brunei are ineligible.
english: IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent English proof (rules vary by university)
deadline: Last cycle (2026/27) closed 15 Feb 2026 (some sources say 28 Feb). Expected around Feb 2027 for the 2027/28 intake.
fitReason: Fully funded, but Brunei's job market is tiny and endorsement through a Pakistani ministry adds hassle.
steps: From Dec 2026, watch the Brunei MFA portal for the 2027/28 call.
Apply online, get the form endorsed through Pakistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or Ministry of Education, and apply to UBD/UTB in parallel.
